title: Personnel of the band that left Kansas City
summary: Dance and Clayton list the band, including Lester Young, Herschel, Keyes, Hunt, Jo Jones, Page, and violinist Claude Williams.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: : Well, this band which left Kansas City consisted of what? Of Lester, Herschel, (Coughy) Roberts?
Coughy Roberts, yes.
: Coughy Roberts.
And Jack Washington.
: Oh, and four saxes when you left?
Right.
: And who were the trumpets then?
Tatti Trumpets were Joe Keyes, Smith and myself.
: The trombones?
The trombones were George Hunt and Eddie Durham.
: Oh Eddie Durham had come in that early?
Eddie Durham came in, let's see now, Eddie Durham, it was either Dan Minor or Eddie Durham.
I think it was Dan Minor when you........
It might have been Dan Minor.
Yes, I think......
(Sure, it might have been Dan Minor?). And yes, Jo Jones, Walter Page and Basie.
Basie, no Freddie Greene? Oh no, you had Claude Williams?
Yes, that's right. Yes, we did have Claude. But see, he didn't really play the in/Reno with us, but he did make, he did go with us to New York.
He was playing guitar?
Guitar and violin.
He played violin with Basie?
Yes, he was a good violinist, hot man.
What did he play? What sort of things did he play?
It was the same thing Stuff Smith was playing.
Oh really? He's not as good as Stuff though, is he?
Ah, no. But he's still playing. He's just recorded.
With Jay McShann.
Yes. I don't think he was as good as Stuff, but he was very good.
